company.name: Monto
company.shortDescription: Monto is a mobile application that offers employees the flexibility to access their earned wages on-demand before payday.
company.description: We help companies improve employee satisfaction, reduce turnover and increase productivity by offering their employees benefits that reduce financial stress. With Monto, users have 24/7 access to their earned wages for a low fixed fee giving them the financial freedom they need to avoid thousands in interest, hidden and overdraft fees.
